extracted.intended_audience: authors, peer reviewers, and editors using PeerJ (journal contributors)
extracted.subtask_description: PeerJ's policy page describing open peer review practices and transparency: which review materials are published, reviewer naming encouragement, and how review histories and timelines are displayed or withheld.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open peer review — reviews made public
rubrics_metrics.description: All reviews of published articles are made public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes manuscript files, peer review comments, author rebuttals and revised materials. Note: This was optional for articles submitted before 13 February 2023.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of materials published with reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: This includes manuscript files, peer review comments, author rebuttals and revised materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All of these components are part of the public record for published articles (subject to the pre-13 Feb 2023 optionality).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer identity disclosure (encouraged, not required)
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer reviewers are encouraged (but not required) to provide their names to the authors when submitting their peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If they agree to provide their name, then their personal profile page will reflect a public acknowledgment that they performed a review (even if the article is rejected). If the article is accepted, then reviewers who provided their name will be associated with the article itself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer review history and timeline transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: The page publishes details of the review process for the article (number of reviewers, Academic Editor involvement, dates of submission, revision, decisions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example content shows initial submission date, reviewer counts, editor decision dates, revision submission dates, and acceptance date. Note that authors may choose not to publish the full peer review history (particularly for articles submitted before 13 February 2023).

rubrics_metrics.name: Author choice for publishing full peer review history (historical exception)
rubrics_metrics.description: The author has chosen not to publish the full peer review history of this article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This reflects the policy exception that making full peer review histories public was optional for articles submitted before 13 February 2023; after that date full-review publication is the default for published articles.
